executivo.nota: Leis: as 173 leis ordinárias e complementares com data a partir de 2/4/2026 cadastradas no SAPL da Câmara, venham de quem vierem (a prefeitura sanciona quase todas). As leis que a própria Câmara promulgou (tipo “Lei Promulgada” no SAPL) ficam fora. Faltam no SAPL 4 dos 153 números de lei do período. Vetos: os projetos que, pelo andamento registrado no SAPL, receberam veto total ou parcial a partir de 2/4/2026.
executivo.nota_en: Laws: the 173 ordinary and complementary laws dated from April 2, 2026 on in the City Council's SAPL system, whoever proposed them (the mayor's office signs almost all of them). Laws promulgated by the Council itself (type “Lei Promulgada” in SAPL) are left out. 4 of the 153 law numbers in the period are missing from SAPL. Vetoes: the bills that, according to the progress recorded in SAPL, were vetoed in whole or in part from April 2, 2026 on.
